question: Seven boxes, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. F is kept second from the bottom. Only three boxes are kept between F and E. D is kept at one of the positions below F. Only A is kept between E and C. B is kept at one of the positions above E. How many boxes are kept between E and D?
